summary: Replaced the oversized monolithic frontstage git-show health probe with the bounded split-service manifest after production dry-run evidence showed stdout buffer exhaustion
issues: spawnSync could not buffer the multi-megabyte monolithic frontstage adapter and silently returned an empty frontstage date
risks: health relies on the split manifest whose monolithic consistency is enforced by the existing frontstage regression suite
lessons: health probes should read bounded manifests rather than full serving payloads
reusable_rules: production health inspection must use bounded persisted control artifacts
